title: The Truck Safety Ratings Nobody Talks About (F-150, Ram and Silverado Failed This Test)
description:
The IIHS safety ratings that never appear in truck ads: the back seat test most pickups fail, headlights, the new automatic braking test and hood height research. Every rating comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:45 The 2026 safety awards
5:12 The back seat test
7:45 F-150, Ram and Silverado in 2026
10:19 Toyota Tundra
11:47 Tesla Cybertruck
13:41 Small and midsize pickups
16:05 Headlights and automatic braking
17:30 Hood height and pedestrians
19:29 Safety checklist for 2027

Sources:
- IIHS, 2026 awards (March 24, 2026): https://iihs.org/news/detail/iihs-pushes-improvements-in-crash-avoidance-with-2026-awards
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, 2026 IIHS safest pickup trucks: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/06/what-are-the-2026-iihs-safest-pickup-trucks/
- Work Truck Online, large pickups falter in back seat safety (2023): https://www.worktruckonline.com/news/large-pickups-falter-in-back-seat-safety
- Work Truck Online, small pickups fall short in rear seat safety (2023): https://www.worktruckonline.com/news/small-pickup-trucks-fall-short-in-rear-seat-safety
- F&I Magazine, new crash test reveals small pickups' weakness: https://www.fi-magazine.com/news/new-crash-test-reveals-small-pickups-weakness
- GM Authority, 2026 GMC Canyon marginal in updated moderate overlap (Sept 3, 2026): https://gmauthority.com/blog/2026/09/2026-gmc-canyon-fails-iihs-updated-moderate-overlap-crash-test-video/
